tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gzhal yas khang gi rnam par bshad pa skal bzang rnams kyi ma rig pa'i ling thog sel ba'i mig thur bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ gzhal yas khang gi sdom ni/ 'og gzhi logs dang steng thog dang / /sgo dang rta babs lnga yis bsdus/ /dang po 'og gzhi pad+ma nyi ma dang / /sna tshogs rdo rje rnam pa gsum/ /dang po ni/ gzhal yas khang gi gdan du gyur pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma/ bla med kyi skabs su rgya bod kyi paṇa grub phal cher mi bzhed/ gal te bzhed na 'dab ma'i grangs ni spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab so gnyis mtshon pas/ phyogs rer 'dab ma brgyad brgyad de so gnyis bya gsungs/ gnyis pa ni/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la srab 'thug gi bshad pa ma byung zhing / rgya tshad ni pad gdan yod pa ltar na/ pad lte dang / nyi ma dang / sna tshogs rdo rje'i shar nub kyi ra rtse'i bar mnyam pas na de gsum gyi rgya la cha phran re bzhi/ pad ra med na zur thig rtse nas bskor bas zlum po/ de'i rgya la re brgyad yod do/ /khyams kyi kha dog ni ljang ser yin te/ 'og gi pad lte ser po des kha dog bsgyur ba'i phyir/ zhes phreng ba mkhan po zer/ rang lugs la gzhal yas khang gi rgyan kha dog sna tshogs 'char bas na ljang khur byas pas kha dog sna tshogs mtshon gsungs/ dbang chur khyams sngon por gsungs pa ni pad ra med par rdo rje'i sa gzhi la dgongs pa'o/ /gsum pa sna tshogs rdo rje ni/ klu byang gis/ rta babs rdo rje rtse mo can/ /zhes bshad pas/ lte ba'i rgya ni mda' yab kyi thig dang tha mi dad du yod la/ cha chen bcu gnyis/ dbyibs ni gru bzhi dang / dpangs la cha chen gcig yin te/ dbus ra'i sked pa sbom pa la cha chen gcig yod par thig gi rigs pas 'grub cing / de dang sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i 'thug srab mnyam zhing / 'og gzhi la thug par mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /dbus ra'i ring thung ni cha chen gnyis yin la/ ra'i grangs ni rten 'brel bcu gnyis mtshon pas phyogs rer ra gsum gsum ste ra bcu gnyis sam/

yang na 'jig lta nyi shu 'joms pa mtshon pas phyogs rer ra lnga lnga ste nyi shu byed pa gang bde'o/ /g.yas g.yon gyi ra'i sked pa sbom pa la cha phran gsum chu srin gyi kha nas 'thon pa man chad srid du dbus ra dang mnyam pa'o/ /kha dog ni phyogs mdog tu byed pa'am/ rtse lnga pa la nang ma phyogs mdog dang / phyi ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdog tu bya ba phreng bar bshad/ ra'i 'thon tshul ni rtse gsum pa bris pa ltar yin/ rtse lnga pa la g.yas g.yon du sbags nas byed pa yin te/ ra yi blor yang gzhan nyid do/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /de rnams kyis 'og gzhi bstan nas/ de'i steng du gzhal yas khang byed tshul mi gcig pa du ma zhig 'byung yang / rang lugs bya rgyud kyi nor bu rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang gi gzhung las/ sa phyogs der rin po che sna bdun gyi khang pa brtsegs ma gru bzhi pa ka ba bzhi gzug pa/ sgo bzhi dod pa mnyam pa nyams dga' ba shin tu rnam par che ba/ ches mdzes par byas pa/ bkra ba/ blta na sdug pa/ them skas bzhi dang ldan pa/ 'phangs su dpag tshad gsum yod pa/ rgyar dpag tshad lnga yod pa zhig byung ngo / /zhes pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ de'i don ni gzhal yas khang gi rgya la dpag tshad ji tsam yod pa de lngar bgos pa'i cha gsum po de/ dpangs su yod pa bstan la/ rgyu mtshan des na 'dir yang gzhal yas khang gi rgya la cha phran so gnyis yod pa'i sum cu po de cha lngar bgos pa'i cha re re ni cha phran drug re yin la/ cha de 'dra ba gsum ni drug gsum bco brgyad do/ /lhag ma cha phran gnyis ni thig skud bcu yin pas/ de ltar bgos pa'i cha chen re ni thig skud gnyis te/ cha de 'dra gsum ni thig skud drug yin la/ de yang thig skud lnga ni cha phran gcig lnga cha gcig 'byung bas/ cha phran gcig dang lnga cha 'di sngar gyi cha phran bco brgyad dang bsdoms nas cha phran bcu dgu dang lnga cha gzhal yas khang gi phyi'i gru bzhi'i dpangs la yod dgos so/

/de ltar na/ logs la rtsig pa pha gu dang / /dra phyed shar bu mda' yab bo/ /zhes bzhi las/ rtsig pa ni mda' thig dang / dbus kyi bar la cha chen drug yod pa'i lnga pa dbus dor/ mtha' gnyis gdab pa'i cha phran gcig ni zheng tshad yin la/ dpangs su cha phran bcu drug rtsig pa rim pa lnga ni/ rgya gar ba kha cig steng nas steng du brtsegs par 'dod kyang / rdo rje rtse mo las/ phyi nang du sbrags nas yod par bshad pa dang 'gal lo/ /brtsig pa'i rim pa ni/ ye shes dang phyogs la dgongs pa gnyis las/ 'dir phyi ma'o/ /de ltar rtsig pa lnga/ sgo mdun du sgo khyud/ sgo 'gram/ sgo logs gyi bar du bri ba ltar 'gro la/ sgo khyud sogs kyi tshad la bshad tshul mi 'dra ba gsum 'byung yang / 'dir sgo khyud gnyis cha chen re rer mnyam/ 'gram logs gnyis cha phran gnyis rer mnyam pa'i lugs te/ de ltar na sgo logs kyi rtsig ngos dang / rdo rje'i lte ba'i mtha'i bar la cha phran gcig yod/ gnyis pa pha gu ni/ dpangs cha phran gcig la rgya cha phran phyed gnyis byas pa'i nang mtha'i rtsig pa dang mnyam la/ cha phran phyed phyir ba gam du 'phyar ba/ kha dog ser po/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi phra zur gsum pa dang / gru bzhi dang / zlum po'i dbyibs can gyis mdzes pa/ de'i steng dra phyed ni/ dpangs su cha phran gnyis bar stongs su yod pa'i skabs su steng gi gdung leb 'degs byed bre phul bzhi brtsegs re/ dpangs su cha phran phyed re/ srid du gong ma gong ma/ cha phran gnyis su phyed re g.yas g.yon du ring ba/ phyi nang du cha phran gcig de'i steng du gser gyi ska rags/ dpangs thig skud gang / rgyar cha chen gcig dang thig skud gang lhag tsam yod pa/ nang mtha' bre phul dang mnyam pa/ phyir cung zad 'phyar yod pa de lta bu'i gdung leb bzhi po yang / chos gos kyi lcags ri ltar zur bsgrigs nas bre phul gyis bteg pa'i gdung gi phyi ngos su chu srin ma ga ra'i kha nas 'phyang ba'i mu tig gi chun 'phyang /

mchog dbus na yod pa'i dra ba dang / mchog mtha' na yod pa'i dra ba phyed pas spras shing / bre phul gyis bar stong rnams mdzes par byas pa/ bzhi pa shar bu ni/ gdung leb dang nang gi gdung zlum gnyis dpangs mnyam por byas pa'i steng nas khyams kyi thog phub pa'i bya 'dab cha phran gnyis phyir lhag pa'i phyam snar rin po che las grub pa'i spyi blug mchu med pa thur du ldog pa/ dpangs cha phran re yod pas spras pa/ lnga pa mda' yab ni/ shar bu'i steng thad kyi gyen du 'grengs te bskor ba/ dbyibs mchod rten bang rim bzhi ma leb mor byas pa lta bu'o/ /de yan chad kyis thog yas/ gdung leb man chad la cha phran bcu dgu lnga cha gcig yod tshul dang / shar bu mda' yab dang bcas pa'i byed tshul bstan zin to/ /gsum pa steng thog 'bubs tshul ni/ steng thog ka ba shing brtsegs dang / /gdung dang thog phub rim gsum mo/ /dang po ka ba ni/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i steng du lha snam phyogs mdog dpangs cha phran gcig pa'i steng du 'dzugs te/ de'ang rtsa thig dang tshangs thig 'dzoms pa'i g.yas g.yon gyis gdung thung rgyud du cha phran lnga re phyin sar cha phran bcu drug gi dpangs dang ldan pa'i ka ba 'khor lo la sogs pa rigs bzhi'i mtshan mas mdzes pa'i ka ba phyogs rer gnyis gnyis brgyad dang ldan pa/ gnyis pa shing brtsegs ni/ ka gzhu la sogs pa'i shing brtsegs bre phul gyi rnam pa can/ dpangs cha phran gcig dang lnga cha gcig yod pa/ gsum pa gdung ni/ ka gzhu'i steng du cha phran gcig pa'i gdung thung rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa/ bzhi pa thog phub la/ sngar ltar nang gi gdung zlum dang phyi'i gser gdung man chad mnyam por yod pa'i steng du phyam rnams gdung nas phyi gru bzhi la nang zlum po'i tshul gyis legs par phub pa'i nang gi rgya mthong sgor mo lta bu stong par yod pa'i gdung zlum gyi steng du rtsig zlum phyogs mdog can gyi dpangs la cha phran gsum/

de'i steng du pha gu cha phran gcig dra phyed gdung leb bsdoms pas dpangs la cha phran gnyis/ de'i steng du cha phran gcig pa'i thal gdung bzhi'i mig mang ris su bris nas phyogs mtshams kyi dra mig brgyad mdzes par phub ste/ phyi ru ji ltar 'tshams pa'i bya 'dab zlum po'i sna la mda' yab dang pu shus mdzes par byas pa'o/ /de steng dbus kyi re mig gru bzhi pa'i gdung steng du rtsig pa sngon po grub bzhi pa'i dpangs la cha phran gsum/ pha gu la cha phran lnga chad pa gcig bre 'bul gdung leb dang bcas pa'i dpang la cha phran gnyis/ de'i steng gru bzhir phub pa'i g.yab ni gru bzhi la mda' yab dang pu shus mdzes shing / rtse mo rdo rje rin po che lta bus brgyan pa/ gzhan yang stod smad kyi thog rgyun gyi phyi mtha' rnams dang sgo khyud sgo 'gram rnams kyi steng du gos dang 'phan la sogs pa'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa'o/ /'di man chad rgya dpang mnyam po yin te/ zlum po 'khor bcas la cha phran drug thal gdung la cha phran gcig grub bzhi 'khor bcas la cha phran drug la lnga cha gcig chad pa/ de ltar na cha phran bcu gsum la lnga cha gcig chad pa'i sngar gyi rnams dang sdoms pas cha phran so gnyis 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa sgo ni/ che chung gnyis las/ 'dir chung ba ste/ dpang cha chen gnyis pa/ sgo logs sogs kyi dpang la cha phran dgu byas pa'i cha phran brgyad kyi steng du bzhag pa'i sgo logs kyi brtsig gdong phan tshun kyi seb du gdung sne gtad la sgo khyud sogs kyis thog mnyam par phub ste/ srab 'thug kyang rtsig pa dang kha dang chod 'ong ba dgos shing / de lta bu'i gdung la cha phran phyed pa'i steng du/ rtsig pa cha phran phyed 'ong ste/ bri bya la ya phub kyi rtsig pa 'ong ba dang mthun no/ /'di'i thog gi sgo khyud 'gram mtshams su ya them ma them gyi dpangs la cha phran phyed re dang / g.yas g.yon gyi sgo skyes la cha phran bzhi cha re yod pa'i ri bzhi bsgrigs ma/

dpangs la cha chen gnyis pa'i sgo glegs gnyis sprad gyi tshul du sbyar bas legs par 'byung ngo / /'dod snam ni kha dog dmar po rgyar cha phran gnyis pa/ rtsig pa'i rtsa bar sgo khyud kyi phyi rol la thug pa'i bar du sleb pa bri bya dang mthun no/ /lnga pa rta babs la lugs mang kyang / 'dir sgo tshad gcig ma yin pas de'i lugs su bshad na/ sgo logs kyi rtsig ngo nas/ g.yas g.yon du cha phran re re song par rdo rje'i lte ba'i steng gi phyi mthar ka ba re dang / de'i thad kyi 'dod snam gyi rtsa bar yang cha phran lnga pa'i ka ba re btsugs pa'i stegs su rta babs snam bu dang po khor mar btang ba'i dpangs cha phran gcig pa/ g.yas g.yon gyi zheng la cha phran gsum re yod pa'i nang mtha' sgo logs kyi rtsig pa la sbyar ba/ phyi mtha' kha rgyan gyi mtha' non pa/ de'i steng snam bu gnyis pa yang sgo logs la sbyar nas 'khor mor btang ba'i g.yas g.yon gyi rgya la cha phran gnyis re yod pa'i phyi mtha' ka ba dang mnyam pa/ de'i steng snam bu gsum pa zhes dang dbang gnyis ka la cha phran gcig yod pa sgo logs la sbyar te 'khor mor snang ngo / /snam bu bzhi pa ni g.yas g.yon gyi sgo logs kyi rtsig pa las cha phran gcig yar lhag nas rang grub kyi tshul du 'byung zhing / sgo mdun gyi bang rim gsum pa'i steng du snam bu bzhi pa srid du cha phran bcu yod pa gcig sgo logs kyi gdong la sbyar bas rtsig pa dang mnyam pa 'byung ste snam bu bzhi pa man chad ka ba dang bcas pa'i dpangs la cha phran dgu yod pa ltar sgo logs kyi rtsig pa'i dpangs la cha phran dgu yod pa gnyis mtshungs so/ /'di'i sgo mdun gyi snam bu bzhi la kha dog gi rim pa la ma gtogs bang rim gyi rnam pa med la/ g.yas g.yon du bang rim bzhi them skas kyi tshul du thig la yod pa ltar dngos su 'byung zhing / rta babs kyi mdun du glang rgyab mig gsum pa'i rnam pa can skol ba'i nam mkha' la dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/

ka rgyan gyi glang po che'i steng du seng ge 'khyil pa'i lag pa ya gcig gis rta babs kyi snam bu 'degs pa'o/ /rta babs bzhi'i steng du chos 'khor gyi gdan gyi pad+ma dpangs cha chung gcig rgyar chos 'khor dang mnyam pa de'i steng du chos 'khor rtsibs brgyad pa'am/ bcu gnyis pa chu zheng du cha chung gnyis yod pa/ de'i steng du gdugs cha chung gcig gi tshad la phye gdugs kyi ngo bo dang phyed yu ba la yod pa/ chos 'khor gyi g.yas g.yon gnyis su cha chung re dor bar ri dwags kṛ ṇa sa ri gnyis dpangs cha phran phyed dang gnyis chos 'khor la kha blta ba/ gzhan yang ba dan dang / dril bu dang bcas pa dang / rin po che'i yu ba can gyi rnga yab la sogs pa'i rgyan sna tshogs pas mdzes par byas pa'o/ /zhes pa 'di yang rgyal ba mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi gsung gi bdud rtsi myong ba'i skal ba bzang po can sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis myur ba nyid du sbyar ba dge legs su gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ gzhal yas khang gi rnam bshad skal bzang rnams kyi ma rig pa'i ling thog sel ba'i mig thur/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
